halloween.costume: an alien costume: a glossy lime-green stretch bodysuit with a stiff, high silver space-age collar, and a lime-green alien hood framing its face, with two oversized glossy black almond-shaped alien eyes on the hood's brow above the pigeon's own, and two bobbing antennae rising straight up from the top of its head, tipped with glowing green orbs
